description: Create a new script in a project. Read the relevant get_documentation topics and use the schema tools first to build valid commands for the bot type. HTTP is a Protocol Bot script, BROWSER is a Browser Bot script, and PLAYWRIGHT is a Playwright script. "Browser script" is ambiguous: Browser Bot and Playwright are different types, so if the user's wording doesn't say which, ask before creating. Don't create multiple scripts of the same type for one task. Edit and reuse a script you created earlier in the session (same type, created by you, not used in a scenario or monitor elsewhere) instead of making a new one for a probe or a retry. Like every write on this surface, returns a summary — the server-assigned facts and a dashboard link — never the object you sent; the matching get tool reads it back.
